public_api_facts.all_runtime_compatible_candidates: The indicated old and selected-runtime candidate APIs satisfy the required public signatures; the newer candidates do not remove APIs but their direct/transitive runtime constraints still govern selection.
public_api_facts.log_api_and_sdk: sdklog.NewLoggerProvider with WithResource and WithProcessor; sdklog.NewBatchProcessor(exporter); LoggerProvider.Shutdown(ctx) drains batch once. log API global.SetLoggerProvider exists in supplied candidates.
public_api_facts.slog_bridge: otelslog.NewHandler(scope, otelslog.WithLoggerProvider(lp)) implements slog.Handler and carries the supplied context trace/span IDs into native LogRecords. A fanout retains a snapshot of the existing standard log writer/prefix/flags; slog.SetDefault can route standard log into this single handler, so snapshot first to avoid recursion/duplicate export.
public_api_facts.http_log_exporter: otlploghttp.New(ctx, WithEndpointURL(exactURL), WithHeaders(emptyMap)) supports http/protobuf and the complete /v1/logs URL. This selected exporter has no grpc transport; switching only an env protocol to grpc cannot make it a grpc exporter.
public_api_facts.trace_metric_exporters: otlptracehttp.New and otlpmetrichttp.New accept the independent configured trace/metric HTTP routes. sdktrace.WithBatcher and sdkmetric.WithReader(NewPeriodicReader) share the same service resource.
public_api_facts.http_runtime: otelhttp.NewHandler(api.Handler(), server) supplies request context plus bounded HTTP trace/metric signals; runtime.Start uses the selected meter provider. No grpc middleware is required by actual source.
